must.subject: Kaynes Technology India Limited has informed the Exchange about Joint Venture Agreements
must.summary: Kaynes Technology India Limited approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved a Joint Venture Agreement with Toyokawa Techno Private Limited to manufacture Thin-Film Transistor Display Modules. The Board also proposed the voluntary strike-off of subsidiary Kaynes Embedded Systems Private Limited, subject to statutory formalities. The auditor's review noted restatements for prior period errors. The consolidated results include a share of net loss from associate Mixx Technologies, Inc. of Rs. 60.02 million for the quarter and Rs. 104.40 million for the six-month period ended September 30, 2026. The auditor could not comment on adjustments related to the associate due to lack of reviewed financials. The meeting concluded at 21:30 IST on November 14, 2026.

enrich.takeaway: Revenue +41% YoY; PAT -25% YoY; margin compressed 1.2pp; profit lagging sales.
